articles.title: Ember Field
articles.summary: Scattered glowing embers with hot cores and cooling halos, vertical heat smear; rough metallic fire sparkle. A faint speckled sheen in the highlight; speck detail blends into a lightly grainy surface.
articles.what: 200-400 glowing embers 3-8 px with hot bright CC cores + cooling outer halos, vertical heat-rise smear, + 8-14 burning coal hot-spots 10-18 px with extra-bright cores, M= Up close: A soft mottled grain of tiny bright specks, 3-8 px, scattered unevenly with small blotchy patches, like fine sand or cinders. Visible inside the highlight band on both halves; a bit brighter on metallic. No glowing halos or heat smear can be seen. From a distance: A faint speckled sheen in the highlight; speck detail blends into a lightly grainy surface. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Fire & Heat (Legacy collection tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
when: Best on: hood, sides, hero panel.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Legacy collection tab and the group "Fire & Heat", or search for "Ember Field".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood and sides under flame or fire paint to add sparkle
Metallic bases where the specks show best
Light grainy speckle in the highlight, mild
Pairs well with: metallic, matte, satin.
pitfalls: Not a fire or ember paint pattern: it adds no orange glow or colour
Not metal flake: specks are irregular blotchy grain, not crisp points
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Ember Field over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
